en.headline: 16 contractors rated poor or very poor on site safety from 2021 to 2025
en.dek: Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn told the Legislative Council that one contractor was rated poor and 15 very poor in quarterly reports, with 2023 seeing the highest number.
body: The government has revealed that 16 contractors received a poor or very poor rating for site safety in quarterly performance reports between 2021 and 2025.

In a written reply to the Legislative Council on Wednesday, Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn detailed the monitoring mechanism for public works contracts. She said technical competence and past performance account for 40 to 50 percent of the overall tender score depending on project complexity, with site safety attributes making up about 30 percent of the technical score.

Linn said contractors are monitored through a quarterly performance assessment, with site safety as a key indicator. An accident rate exceeding 0.3 reportable accidents per 100,000 man-hours worked rates the site accident record as poor. An accident involving serious bodily injury results in a poor or very poor rating for the entire site safety attribute, while a fatal accident automatically triggers a very poor rating.

Data showed one contractor rated poor in 2023, while seven others were rated very poor that year—the highest number in the five-year period. The figure for very poor ranged from one to three in other years. In serious cases, the Development Bureau can suspend a contractor from tendering for public works or remove them from the approved lists. The Housing Authority can also deduct marks from safety performance scores.

Linn said the government has been promoting wider adoption of the Smart Site Safety System, which uses technology to identify unsafe acts and potential risks early. The Housing Authority has integrated the data into an AI-powered platform to strengthen monitoring.

zh.headline: 2021至2025年有16間承建商工地安全被評欠佳或極差
zh.dek: 發展局局長甫漢豪書面回覆立法會，指過去五年有一間承建商評為欠佳、十五間極差，2023年極差數目最多。
body: 政府透露，2021至2025年間有16間承建商在季度表現評核報告中，工地安全表現被評為欠佳或極差。
發展局局長甫漢豪周三以書面回覆立法會議員質詢，詳述工務工程合約的監察機制。她表示，評審標書時，技術能力及過往表現佔整體評分四至五成，視乎項目複雜程度而定，而工地安全屬性約佔技術評分三成。
甫漢豪指，承建商透過季度表現評核監察，工地安全是主要指標。若意外率超過每十萬工時0.3宗可報告意外，工地意外紀錄會被評為欠佳。涉及嚴重身體傷害的意外會令整個工地安全表現屬性評為欠佳或極差，而致命意外則自動觸發極差評級。
數據顯示，2023年有一間承建商被評為欠佳，另有七間被評為極差，是五年期間最高數字。其他年份極差數目由一至三間不等。嚴重個案下，發展局可暫停承建商投標工務工程合約，甚至從認可名冊除名。房屋委員會亦可在涉及致命或嚴重工業意外時，從安全表現評分及未來標書評估中扣分。
甫漢豪表示，政府一直推動更廣泛採用安全智慧工地系統，利用科技及早識別不安全行為及潛在風險。房屋委員會已將相關數據整合至人工智能平台，加強監察承建商的安全表現。
